title: Austin's Future Transport & Funding Plans
summary:
*   City leaders unveiled "Austin on the Move," a new initiative addressing urban mobility.
*   Major announcements focused on next steps for critical transportation improvements.
*   Discussions centered on securing future funding for these vital infrastructure projects.
